context.transcript:
Malik and Roberto, I have bad news.
Larson Incorporated decided not to sponsor our music festival this year.
Oh no, we were really counting on their contribution.
I've already started asking other local businesses to consider sponsoring the event.
I stopped by Rogers Bookstore this morning and they donated $500.
That's good news.
You know, we could also ask the new pharmacy on First Street.
Roberto, would you mind giving them a call today?
Sure.
And actually, my brother's one of the pharmacists there.
So maybe he can help us out.
context.transcript_translation:
Malik和Roberto，我有个坏消息。
Larson Incorporated决定今年不赞助我们的音乐节了。
哦不，我们非常指望他们的贡献。
我已经开始向其他本地企业询问是否考虑赞助活动了。
我今天早上去了Rogers Bookstore，他们捐了500美元。
这是个好消息。
你知道，我们也可以问一下第一街新开的药店。
Roberto，你今天能给他们打个电话吗？
好的。
实际上，我哥哥就是那里的药剂师之一。
所以也许他能帮到我们。
